decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right colors: green, red, blue. Begin elbow-up approach to left cover; right arm stays home.
Align downward gripper over left cup, then descend open to grasp height. Verify alignment before closing.
Close left gripper on cup and lift vertically, keeping its orientation. Check retention in wrist and head views.
Carry retained left cup over the green block and begin lowering without rotation; cover leftmost first.
Seat first cup over green, release, and lift clear. Green remains the leftmost remembered block.
First cup appears seated over green. Move left arm clear and approach center cup next, without crossing into right workspace.
Descend on center cup, close fully, and lift to check retention before covering the red center block.
Center cup retained. Raise for block clearance, carry forward over red, then lower with unchanged orientation; left cup remains in place.
Release second cup over red and lift left gripper clear. Begin mirrored elbow-up right-arm approach to the third cup; keep arms separated.
Align right gripper downward above the third cup and descend open. Left arm waits clear above the covered red block.
Close right gripper fully around third cup, then lift vertically while maintaining cup orientation. Check retention before forward transfer.
Third cup retained in RGB. Carry it over the blue block and lower upright, completing covering left to right before any uncovering.
Seat and release the third cup over blue. Lift right arm clear while left descends to grasp the red center cover; no uncovering lift yet.
All three cups now appear seated. Uncover red first by lifting the center cup and carrying it toward the clear front row; green and blue remain covered.
Red cup is lifted and retained. Replan the rejected rearward transfer with smaller increments from the observed pose; leave green and blue covered.
Lower the removed red cover into the clear front-center area, release upright, and lift away. Keep both remaining blocks covered.
Move left gripper clear of the removed center cover and above the left green cover for the second uncovering. Right arm stays above blue without lifting its cup.
Grasp the left green cover for the second uncovering. Right gripper may prepare its blue grasp but stays at table height; no blue lift before green is exposed.
Uncover green second: lift the left cup and carry it to the front-left area. Hold blue's cover stationary until green is visibly clear.
Green is visibly uncovered after red. Place its cup front-left; now uncover blue last by lifting and moving its cover to the front-right, maintaining orientation.
Blue is visibly uncovered last. Set its cup front-right and release upright. Begin left-arm return along a raised, continuous elbow-up path; right lifts away after release.
All blocks are exposed and cups are upright in front. Return left arm toward origin while right retracts clear, using small continuous orientation and position increments.
Finish returning both empty grippers to their original poses. Cups stay upright in the front row and all three blocks remain uncovered.
